scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels beneath a tree, looking upward with open hands as golden light shines through clouds above a distant town.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus lifting His eyes toward heaven and praying to the Father, asking that the Son be glorified so the Son may glorify the Father. The setting and visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with open hands among a gathering of men, women, and children beneath a flourishing tree, with warm sunlight and a distant landscape behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus' authority and the gift of eternal life to those given to him, as described in John 17:2. The gathering and landscape are visual metaphors, not a depicted event stated in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a leafy tree among attentive adults and children, gesturing toward the bright sky in a flower-filled landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting John 17:3: eternal life is knowing the only true God and Jesus Christ, whom God sent. The gathering and setting are visual interpretation, not events specified by this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands on a rocky hillside with open hands and looks toward sunlight breaking through clouds above a broad valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 17:4: Jesus speaks of glorifying the one addressed on earth and completing the work given to him. The hillside and landscape are artistic choices, not details specified in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels on a rocky hillside with his hands raised in prayer toward radiant golden light, beneath a deep blue sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus praying to the Father, with radiant light suggesting the glory he had with the Father before the world existed.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels in prayer among attentive disciples beneath trees, with a sunlit village and hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus' prayer that he revealed the Father's name to the people the Father gave him, and that they have kept the Father's word; the setting and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree with open hands and looks toward sunlight in the sky as a small group of followers listens nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflects the verse's statement that they have come to know that all Jesus has been given is from the one he addresses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to disciples gathered beneath a tree, overlooking a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the words Jesus gave his followers and their receptive trust, reflecting John 17:8 without claiming to depict the historical setting.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels with clasped hands and looks upward in prayer while five disciples sit nearby beneath an olive tree, with a sunlit village and hills in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus praying for those the Father has given him, reflecting John 17:9 rather than depicting a specified historical setting.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with open hands and looks upward in prayer as a small group gathers around him beneath a tree, in a golden sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the shared belonging expressed in John 17:10 and Jesus being glorified in them. The setting, people, and golden light are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks upward in prayer as a close-knit group of followers gathers around him beneath a tree, with golden light over a distant village and hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus' prayer that the Holy Father keep those remaining in the world in His name, so that they may be one; the setting and visible light are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands among a close group of followers beneath a tree at sunset, resting a hand on one man's shoulder as a lone figure walks away along a distant path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jesus keeping and guarding those with him, with a solitary departing figure suggesting the verse's exception; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree, looking upward with open hands as four listeners gather around Him in a sunlit landscape with a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus speaking to the Father while in the world and His desire that His joy be fulfilled within those for whom He speaks.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus prays beneath a tree among attentive followers while several people nearby turn away or watch with hostile expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus giving God's word to his followers and the world's hatred of them because they, like him, are not of the world.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in prayer beneath a tree overlooking people walking through a sunlit village, while dark clouds gather over distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus praying for his followers to be kept from evil while they remain in the world, as expressed in John 17:15.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with a small group of followers beneath an olive tree on a sunlit hillside, with a busy ancient town in the valley beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the shared relationship to the world described in John 17:16: Jesus and his followers are together in an earthly setting, yet are not of the world.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus prays beneath a tree as followers gather around a glowing, unlettered scroll, with sunlight over a distant landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the glowing scroll and light as visual metaphors for the prayer to sanctify them by the truth and for God's word as truth.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends a hand toward followers walking down a sunlit hillside path toward a village, with fields, water and mountains beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 17:18's comparison between the sending of Jesus into the world and his sending of them into the world. The setting and depicted moment are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath an olive tree with one hand over his heart, looking upward as a group of listeners gathers around him in a sunlit garden.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus' dedication for his followers, reflecting his words that they also may be sanctified in truth. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits praying beneath a tree while a disciple speaks to a circle of attentive listeners in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jesus asking not only for those with him, but also for people who believe in him through their word; the setting and gathering are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks upward in prayer among a diverse group gathered beneath a tree, while others approach from a village across a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus praying and people gathered in unity, suggesting his prayer that they may be one in the Father and the Son so that the world may believe the Father sent him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends his hands toward a close circle of followers as warm golden light falls over them in a village courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene uses shared light and a gathered circle to suggest the glory Jesus has given and the unity described in John 17:22.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits closely with a group of followers beneath a sunlit tree, their arms around one another as other people watch nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of fellowship and shared light evokes Jesus' prayer that his followers be brought into unity, and that the world know the Father sent him and loved them as he loved him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among followers in a flowered landscape, looking upward with open hands as golden light radiates behind him; the followers look toward him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus' prayer that those the Father gave him would be with him and behold his glory. The radiant light suggests the Father's love before the foundation of the world.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks upward in prayer as a small group of listeners gathers around him on a sunlit hillside, with a town in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus addressing the righteous Father while those around him listen, reflecting John 17:25 and its contrast between the world not knowing the Father and these knowing that the Father sent Jesus.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree with open hands, speaking to a small group of attentive followers in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jesus making the Father's name known and the love and presence he desires to be in his followers, as expressed in John 17:26.
